definitions.explanation: The fees and costs associated with attending school or receiving education.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{学費|がくひ}は{高|たか}い。
{奨学金|しょうがくきん}で{学費|がくひ}を{払|はら}っている。
examples.english: I'm paying tuition with a scholarship/student loan.

examples.japanese: {学費|がくひ}のためにアルバイトをしている。
examples.english: I'm working part-time to pay for school expenses.

notes:
{学費|がくひ} is a compound: {学|がく} (study/school) + {費|ひ} (expense).

COMPONENTS OF {学費|がくひ}:
- {授業料|じゅぎょうりょう} (tuition fees)
- {入学金|にゅうがくきん} (enrollment fee)
- {施設費|しせつひ} (facility fees)
- {教材費|きょうざいひ} (textbook/materials costs)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学費|がくひ}を{払|はら}う (to pay tuition)
- {学費|がくひ}を{稼|かせ}ぐ (to earn tuition money)
- {学費|がくひ}が{足|た}りない (not have enough for tuition)
- {学費|がくひ}{免除|めんじょ} (tuition exemption)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {奨学金|しょうがくきん} (scholarship / student loan)
- {教育費|きょういくひ} (educational expenses - broader term)
- {授業料|じゅぎょうりょう} (tuition - specific term)
